Short title and commencement

THE DEPUTY COMMANDER IN CHIEF (POWERS) ORDINANCE, 1942
THE DEPUTY
COMMANDER‑IN‑CHIEF (POWERS) ORDINANCE, 1942.
ORDINANCE No. XXII
of 1942
[22nd May,
1942]
An Ordinance to
provide for the exercise by an officer appointed by the Central Government of
certain powers and functions vested in the Commander‑in‑Chief of (Subs. by A. O., 1961, Art. 2 and Sch., for "His
Majesty's Forces in India" (with effect from the 23rd March, 1956).)[the
Pakistan Army].
WHEREAS an emergency has arisen
which makes it necessary to provide for the exercise by an officer appointed by
the Central Government of certain powers and functions vested in the Commander‑in‑Chief
of (Subs. by the Federal Laws (Revision and
Declaration) Act, 1951 (26 of 1951), s. 4 and 3rd Sch., for "His Majesty's
Forces in India".)[the Pakistan Army].
Now, THEREFORE, in exercise of
the powers conferred by section 72 of the Government of India Act, as set out
in the Ninth Schedule to the Government of India Act, 1935, the Geo. Governor‑General
is pleased to make and promulgate the 5, c. following Ordinance:‑‑
26 Geo 5,c.2.
1. Short title and
commencement------‑(1) This Ordinance may be called the Deputy Com mander‑in‑Chief
(Powers) Ordinance, 1942.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.
